name: Lively Photos Director
subtitle: Direct human-first photos
description: Lively Photos Director directs photorealistic, believable, human-first images from real-person reference photos. Powered by a Smart Dynamic Router and specialized agentic skills, it preserves immutable facial landmarks and authentic skin texture while calculating optical camera parameters, coherent physical lighting, and realistic context across corporate documentary, candid professional, editorial, event, and everyday lifestyle modes. It compiles engine-optimized prompts for ChatGPT/DALL-E 3, Midjourney, Flux.1, and SDXL, and runs closed-loop visual QA against 6 realism gates with surgical delta inpainting repair.
capabilities: Smart dynamic routing across photographic modes, identity locking, prompt compilation, and visual QA
Facial landmark anchoring and skin texture preservation without plastic AI airbrushing
Photographic scene direction with precise focal length, aperture, and depth-of-field optics
Physical lighting coherence aligning key light, window daylight, shadows, and eye catchlights
Multi-engine prompt compilation tailored for Midjourney v6, Flux.1, ChatGPT/DALL-E 3, and SDXL
6-Gate realism quality audit detecting anatomical, optical, lighting, and synthetic slop defects
Surgical delta revision instructions for bounded inpainting fixes without full prompt regeneration
Host-native workspace operations for inspecting reference photos and verifying output assets
starterPrompts: Direct a natural corporate documentary photo of our CEO in an executive boardroom from this reference
Lock my facial features from this portrait and direct an editorial natural outdoor magazine profile
Audit this generated photo against the 6 realism gates and generate a surgical delta inpainting prompt
